slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: “哇靠，还真穿越了，太爽了，哈哈哈！”
轰的一声，虚空划过一道闪电，一个帅的昏天黑地、日月失色，几乎人神共愤的少年从天而降。
他叫苏长歌，是个货真价实的蓝星人。
前世是个老书虫，喜欢看各种玄幻小说。
看的多了。
就对玄幻世界充满了幻想。
玄幻世界美女如云，仙兽成群。
修行者御剑飞行，摘星拿月。
更有大能者一剑开天门，剑气纵横三万里。
那是说不尽的风流，道不完的潇洒。
令他向往不已，很想穿越到这。
于是今天放学后，他对着天空大喊：“穿越！”
天空轰隆一声响。
然后还真穿越到这来了。
美梦成真！
可太爽了！
穿越成功，他立刻开始查看自己的修为。
毕竟玄幻世界讲究的是实力为尊。
嗯？
不查不要紧，这一查，苏长歌顿时愣住了。
修为……是0？
这还怎么御剑飞行？
还怎么耍帅？
他急忙查看身体，这才发现自己肉身凡体，体内有很多杂质。
这些杂质堵塞了经脉，导致灵气无法流通。
自然无法吸收天地间的灵气。
而且天赋也不高。
“不是吧，竟然这开局？”
苏长歌有些无语。
时光悠悠而过，眨眼五年过去。
这一天，苏长歌走在山路上，心情郁闷。
“唉，五年前刚穿越的时候修为是0，这都五年后了，还是0！”
回顾这穿越的五年，心里有很多苦想说。
本以为穿越后的日子会很潇洒。
像很多小说那样，帅气，资质逆天，美女主动投怀，异兽主动臣服。
可结果呢？
content_en:
"Wow, I really traveled through time. It's so cool, hahaha!"
With a bang, a flash of lightning flashed across the sky, and a handsome young man fell from the sky, the sky was dark, the sun and the moon were eclipsed, and almost everyone and the gods were angry.
His name is Su Changge, and he is a genuine Blue Star man.
In my previous life, I was an old bookworm and loved reading all kinds of fantasy novels.
See too much.
I am full of fantasy about the fantasy world.
In the fantasy world, there are clouds of beauties and hordes of fairy beasts.
Practitioners fly with swords and reach for the stars and the moon.
There is even a powerful person who opens the gate of heaven with a sword, and the sword energy stretches across thirty thousand miles.
It was an indescribable romance, an endless splendor.
It made him yearn for it, and he wanted to travel here.
So after school today, he shouted to the sky: "Time travel!"
There was a rumble in the sky.
Then I really traveled through time and came here.
A dream come true!
It’s so cool!
After successfully traveling through time, he immediately began to check his cultivation level.
After all, the fantasy world is all about strength.
Um?
It didn't matter if he didn't check. Su Changge was stunned when he checked.
Repair...
Cultivation...is 0?
How can you still fly with a sword?
How can you act cool?
He hurriedly checked his body and found that his body was mortal and there were many impurities in his body.
These impurities block the meridians, preventing spiritual energy from flowing.
Nature cannot absorb the spiritual energy between heaven and earth.
And the talent is not very high.
"Isn't it? This is the start?"
Su Changge was speechless.
~~~~~~~
Time passed by slowly, and five years passed in the blink of an eye.
On this day, Su Changge was walking on the mountain road, feeling depressed.
"Oh, my cultivation level was 0 when I first traveled through time five years ago. Five years later, it's still 0!"
Looking back on these five years, I have a lot to say.
I thought that the days after time travel would be very relaxed.
Like many novels, he is handsome, has extraordinary talents, beauties take the initiative to throw themselves into his arms, and strange beasts surrender to him.
But what's the result?
